subject: release-tooling/update-runtime-directory
statement: All update execution state belongs under Git-ignored .agent-updates/: incoming scenarios, isolated run directories, logs, copied scenario snapshots, artifacts, periodic state, and transient recovery helpers. Git stores product/source changes and reusable semantic knowledge, not update execution debris.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Preserve reusable R7 declarative-update, recovery, and automatic-update lessons after successful 0.16.2 dogfood.
